traits.Keen Hearing and Smell: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
traits.Pack Tactics: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.note: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
